WITH per_account AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
                WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
            END) AS average_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
    GROUP BY account_id
),
mean_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_amount
    FROM per_account
)
SELECT
    p.account_id,
    p.average_amount,
    p.average_amount - m.mean_amount AS amount_above_mean
FROM per_account AS p
CROSS JOIN mean_average AS m
WHERE p.average_amount > m.mean_amount
ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
